## What’s new
- Allows intentional referral-payment email resends while continuing to protect automatic delivery from duplicates. - Adds fast shared memory and disk caching for contact avatar photos throughout Beacon. - Shows clearer resend wording and cleaner server error messages in the referral-email preview.

## What’s new
- Makes referral-payment email headers reliable across mail clients with a lighter, professional statement design. - Returns every sidebar section to its usual landing view when its sidebar tab is clicked. - Returns Dashboard to My Dashboard, Time to Day, and Payables to Open.

## Payee photos on Payables
- Shows each person's uploaded profile photo in Payables and Paid History. - Keeps the person's photo visible even when their QuickBooks payment recipient is a company. - Falls back to the live Contacts directory when a payable's cached photo field is missing.

## What’s new
- Makes column resizing across Beacon’s embedded reports feel smooth and stable. - Uses wider windows to give report columns more comfortable spacing and reduce unnecessary wrapping. - Shows Date Paid in Paid History and sorts the newest payments first. - Automatically receives QuickBooks Bill payment updates through webhooks, with a read-only recovery check every 15 minutes. - Keeps a visible “Check now” fallback on scheduled QuickBooks-linked payables.
Referral-payment emails remain manual while delivery is in testing.

## What’s new
- Restores complete invoice detail rows in referral-payment email previews for imported payables, including Sharon’s payables #321 and #331. - Adds a clear **Preview & Send** workflow with a confirmation step directly on the payable form. - Keeps referral email testing locked to `h.wright@vervetechgroup.com`; neither Sharon nor company-copy recipients receive test emails. - Adds **Check QuickBooks** on scheduled payables so Beacon can reread the linked Bill and apply a verified BillPayment.
## Fixes
- Correctly marks a scheduled Beacon payable as paid when its exactly linked QuickBooks Bill has a zero balance and a verified linked BillPayment. - Keeps automatic referral-email delivery disabled so status synchronization never sends an email unexpectedly.

## What’s new
- Adds referral-payment email previews directly in Beacon, with a cleaner payment-detail layout and a guarded delivery workflow. - Keeps referral email delivery in Hannah-only test mode while the workflow is reviewed. - Adds optional contact profile photos and uses them in contact and payable views, falling back to initials when no photo is available. - Cleans up payable reporting, including removing the no-longer-relevant Due in column from paid payables. - Streamlines account settings with side-by-side name fields, modal password workflows, and dashboard routing after sign-in.
## Reliability
- Improves billing-rule parity, local finance caching, system-health visibility, and client-app time-log delivery safeguards.

## Fixed
- The Cash Flow dashboard now lists projected referral payments that are waiting for client invoices to be paid. - Each projected row shows the client, invoice, expected client-payment date, referrer, and projected payout, and opens the source invoice when selected. - The Waiting on clients total now includes those projected payouts without double-counting legacy blocked payables.

## Fixed
- Referral payables now display their contractual due date, 30 days after client payment, instead of the payment date. - The Days column now counts down to that contractual due date.

## What’s new
- Streamlined invoicing with a full-screen draft workflow, live time-log edits, and a clearer QuickBooks handoff with success confirmation. - Added subscription billing support, payment history, and revenue-share calculations. - Improved payable and QuickBooks bill readiness so approved obligations can move directly into payment. - Added automatic recovery when a session expires, longer-lived sign-ins, password reset by email, and Apple Passwords support. - Added the role-scoped client and subcontractor portal foundation.
## Reliability
- Improved live Convex synchronization and release signing for the new secure-login entitlement.

# Beacon 1.0.6
- Added a fully isolated Showcase Mode that uses Beacon's production interface with realistic fake data and blocks production data, QuickBooks, Quickbase, and other external connections. - Updated Day and Week calendars to prioritize billable work, show earned revenue, and keep personal-project time secondary. - Added billable hours and earned revenue to every day in the Week calendar while removing the project icons from day headings. - Renamed the Current Work cards to Today, This week, and This month for clearer language. - Hardened test launches so they cannot restore production authentication or connect to production services.
